name: tz-transfer-pricing
description: Tanzania transfer pricing for 2026: the arm's length rule in Income Tax Act s.33, the Tax Administration (Transfer Pricing) Regulations 2018, documentation at the TZS 10 billion threshold, the Finance Act 2026 penalty, intra-group services and advance pricing arrangements. Use for related-party pricing, TP documentation, or TRA TP adjustment questions in Tanzania.
